personality_one_liner: A sharp, command-center interface that feels like a live operational surface for digital real estate, prioritizing glanceability and grid interaction.

spacing.rule: Use tight padding for data rows and generous padding (md/lg) for distinct modular cards. Components like map overlays should float over the safe area with strict md margins.

do's: Use heavy glass effect for the floating HUDs (Coin balance, User Profile pill) resting over the grid map.
Use frosted glass on the bottom sheet handle/header when dragging.
dont's: Do not blur individual pixel blocks.
Do not use glass behind dense form fields or data tables in the admin panel.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Frictionless entry via Google Login into the PixelLand ecosystem.

states.error: Error toast indicating login failure with a retry CTA.

screens.layout: Minimalist centered layout. Dark background with a subtle ambient radial gradient of brandTertiary. Large display title 'PixelLand' using Rajdhani. Single prominent Google Login button styled as a surfaceSecondary pill with borderStrong outline.

screens.name: Map
screens.purpose: The core experience: an interactive, zoomable, and pannable 20x20 grid representing digital real estate.

states.loading: Skeleton grid showing placeholder blocks pulsing.
states.error: Full-screen dark error state asking to reload the map data.

screens.layout: Edge-to-edge interactive grid map using gesture-handler. Overlay: Top-left pill with user avatar and pixel count; Top-right pill showing Pixel Coins wallet balance (using glassmorphism). Bottom: Non-modal bottom sheet that slides up when a pixel is tapped. The map remains interactive while the sheet is visible.

screens.name: PixelDetails
screens.purpose: Displayed via the bottom sheet: shows owner info, pixel coordinates, description, and purchase actions.

states.loading: Skeleton layout for title and owner info.
states.error: Text reading 'Could not fetch pixel data' with retry.

screens.layout: Rendered inside @gorhom/bottom-sheet. Top half: Cover photo (with bottom-fade scrim) or abstract digital banner. Bottom half: High-contrast data rows (Owner, Coords, Price). If available: Sticky primary CTA 'Buy Pixel' fixed to the bottom of the sheet with safe-area padding.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Shows the user's acquired pixels, total coin balance, and basic Google account info.
screens.layout: Header: Large avatar with display name and Coin balance in an elevated surfaceSecondary card. Body: Grid or list of owned Pixels with thumbnail cover images and coordinates.

screens.name: Admin
screens.purpose: Management panel to edit users, alter pixel info, or mint new pixels.
screens.layout: Dense, utility-first list view. Segmented control at the top to toggle between 'Users' and 'Pixels'. High information density with subtle dividers. No glassmorphism here, pure tactical UI.

pixel_cover_default.alt: Abstract aerial night city serving as default pixel territory cover

user_avatar_placeholder.alt: Default user avatar with dark neon aesthetic

instructions_to_main_agent: Design Identity: Strictly adhere to '7. Dark-First Utility DARK' using the provided palette. Do NOT introduce other shades of blue or purple. The accent is electric cyan (#00E5FF).

Map Interaction: The core mechanic is the 20x20 grid map. Implement panning and zooming using react-native-gesture-handler and react-native-reanimated. Ensure smooth 60fps performance by avoiding re-renders of the entire 400-pixel grid on every gesture.

Bottom Sheet Pattern: The 'PixelDetails' view must be implemented as a non-modal bottom sheet using @gorhom/bottom-sheet. When a user taps a pixel, slide up the sheet but leave the background map fully visible and interactive. Do not block the map with a dark modal scrim.

HUD Elements: The user's profile summary (Avatar + Pixel count) and their Pixel Coins wallet should float over the map as sticky HUD pills using glassmorphism (expo-blur) or solid surfaceTertiary backgrounds.
Typography: Use Rajdhani for all numbers, metrics, coordinates, and display titles. Use IBM Plex Sans for standard body text.
Images & Textures: Apply the mandatory linear-gradient scrim (top-to-bottom fade) over the pixel_cover_default image when displaying text on top of it in the bottom sheet or profile.
